name: NeRF-Casting Optimization and Representation
definition: View-dependent color MLP $M_c$ inputs: position $\mathbf{x}$, bottleneck vector $\mathbf{b}$, normal $\mathbf{n}$, view direction $\mathbf{d}$, and camera position with low-degree positional encoding of degree 2: $(\cos(\mathbf{o}), \sin(\mathbf{o}), \cos(2\mathbf{o}), \sin(2\mathbf{o}))$.
summary: NeRF-Casting is a volume rendering method that improves glossy surface appearance by modeling reflections with separate hash grids and MLPs for view-dependent and reflection-dependent colors.
